Package io.mavlink4j.testkit

package io.mavlink4j.testkit
Test doubles for code that talks MAVLink through mavlink4j, with no SITL, socket or hardware needed: a scripted FakeVehicle, in-memory links (RecordingLink, LoopbackLinkPair) and deterministic time (ManualInstantSource, DirectTxScheduler).
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    io.mavlink4j
    L0 — identity value types (SysId, CompId, PeerId, VehicleKind, MavlinkNode).
  • Class
    Description
    CommandReply
    What a FakeVehicle does when a scripted command arrives: send zero or more COMMAND_ACKs.
    CommandRequest
    A command a FakeVehicle received.
    DirectTxScheduler
    A TxScheduler with no threads and no timers: DirectTxScheduler.submit(java.lang.String, java.lang.Runnable) runs inline and a DirectTxScheduler.repeat(java.lang.String, java.time.Duration, java.lang.Runnable) registration only fires when the test calls DirectTxScheduler.tick().
    DirectTxScheduler.Registration
    One DirectTxScheduler.repeat(java.lang.String, java.time.Duration, java.lang.Runnable) registration, observable by the test.
    FakeVehicle
    A scripted aircraft over real UDP loopback: it dials the system under test, sends a heartbeat every 200 ms by default (one heartbeat can be lost on plain UDP while the far side is still binding, so the stream never stops), records every frame it receives, and answers on demand or by script.
    FakeVehicle.Builder
    Describes a FakeVehicle; FakeVehicle.Builder.build() starts it.
    LoopbackLinkPair
    Two MavlinkLinks wired back to back in memory: what one sends, the other polls.
    ManualInstantSource
    An InstantSource that only moves when the test says so, for MavlinkSettings.builder().clock(...).
    RecordingLink
    An in-memory MavlinkLink that records every RecordingLink.send(byte[], int, int, io.mavlink4j.transport.LinkPeer) instead of touching a socket, and hands back whatever the test injects from RecordingLink.poll(java.time.Duration).
